subject: Coverage hedge + commitment surge plan for Nebula Analytics
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Diane Park <diane@nebula-analytics.com>
Cc: procurement@nebula-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Coverage hedge + commitment surge plan for Nebula Analytics

Team / Diane —

Quick note to jump-start a short run-rate intervention for Nebula. Finance ran numbers this morning and we have a clear coverage gap into Q3 if we don't tighten open opportunities and secure a handful of near-term commits. High-level snapshot (attached):

- Account quota (FY26): $1.2M
- Current weighted pipeline (next 90d): $680k (57% coverage)
- Target coverage to meet Q3 inflow: 120% (~$1.44M)
- Current effective gap: ~$760k

Goal: a focused 10-business-day sprint to lock $350–500k of committed bookings or credible PO/procurement steps that finance can treat as near-term revenue.

Requesting the following by EOD Wednesday (2026-05-13):
1) Each AE/SE to update stage and close-prob notes in HubSpot for all Nebula-opps (link below).
2) A filled mutual action plan (attached template) for any opp > $50k with clear dates: technical sign-off, procurement, PO issuance.
3) Marcus / Finance to confirm the minimum documentation they need to classify something as "commit" for forecast inclusion.

I attached a compact coverage snapshot and the mutual_action_template.xlsx — will follow up with a short working session if Diane can confirm procurement timing. Proposed meeting windows: Thu 5/14 10:00–10:30 PT or Thu 5/14 15:00–15:30 PT.

Thanks — short and tactical here.

—Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0191
Redwood Inference

Attachments: coverage_snapshot_Q2.pdf (1.2MB), mutual_action_template.xlsx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Diane Park <diane@nebula-analytics.com>, procurement@nebula-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coverage hedge + commitment surge plan for Nebula Analytics

+1 on Naomi's ask. A couple of clarifications from finance so the team knows what counts as near-term committed value:

- "Forecasted commit" requires: signed contract or signed LOI + a dated PO OR a written procurement timeline with named approvers and an explicit expected PO date.
- For large deals ($200k+), we'll accept a draft PO plus procurement calendar; smaller deals need a signed SOW or explicit email from procurement authorizing a purchase.
- Discounting: anything >10% needs pre-approval from finance leadership — flag so I can fast-track the review if needed.

Operational asks for the sprint:
- Update HubSpot close dates to reflect the procurement ETA (not the optimistic internal close).
- Use the mutual action plan for all opps > $50k. Sales owners should attach the MAP to the HubSpot record.

I can join the working session Thu 5/14 at 10:00 PT.

Marcus Lin
Head of Rev Ops, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: Diane Park <diane@nebula-analytics.com>

Cc: procurement@nebula-analytics.com, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coverage hedge + commitment surge plan for Nebula Analytics

Hi Naomi / team —

Thanks for the clear ask and the attachments. We're aligned on the urgency. A quick update from procurement side:

- We can likely move on two items this month: Prod Trial Expansion (expected PO ~$180k) and a Support Add-on (expected PO ~$45k).
- Procurement can issue draft PO for the Support Add-on by 5/21 if we confirm pricing. The Prod Trial Expansion needs a technical sign-off from our infra team — they can complete that by 5/19.
- I attached a preliminary PO draft (Nebula_PO_draft.docx) with placeholders for billing terms and contact.

Questions for Redwood:
1) Can you confirm whether a draft PO + MAP will be acceptable as a qualified commit for Marcus/finance?
2) We may need a short-term credit note/credit hold window on final payment terms — is that something Redwood offers for pilot-to-production transitions?

We are available for the Thu 5/14 15:00 PT slot. Please send a meeting invite and an agenda.

Best,
Diane Park
Director of IT Procurement
Nebula Analytics

Attachments: Nebula_PO_draft.docx

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Diane Park <diane@nebula-analytics.com>, procurement@nebula-analytics.com
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coverage hedge + commitment surge plan for Nebula Analytics

Diane —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. To answer: yes, Marcus and finance will accept a draft PO + completed MAP as a near-term commit for inclusion in the forecast, provided the MAP shows named approvers and firm PO dates. We will need the signed MAP attached to the HubSpot record.

On the credit/terms question: we can offer a 30-day invoice hold for pilot conversions in cases where procurement provides a dated PO. We typically do not extend credit beyond that without a corporate payment agreement; if Nebula needs more flexible terms, we can escalate to the finance contracts team — please let me know and I'll loop them in.

Meeting confirmed Thu 5/14 15:00 PT. Agenda (15 mins):
- 3m: goal + current coverage numbers (Naomi)
- 5m: procurement timeline and PO expectations (Diane)
- 5m: action items & HubSpot attachments (Marcus)
- 2m: next steps and dates

I'll send the invite now and attach the MAP to the HubSpot record (link).

Thanks — looking forward to locking the PO.

—Naomi

Quick internal note / action list after the call — logging here so nothing falls through the cracks.

- Naomi: attach completed MAP to HubSpot opp NEB-Prod-EXP (HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/records/NEBULA-12345) by EOD today.
- Naomi / Diane: finalize pricing confirmation for Support Add-on (needs to be firm for 5/21 draft PO).
- Marcus: confirm whether 30-day invoice hold is recorded as a usable concession for forecasting; if yes, mark the Prod Trial Expansion as "forecastable" once draft PO is uploaded.
- Logan: I'll update close dates in HubSpot to match procurement ETA (Prod Trial -> 2026-05-19; Support Add-on -> 2026-05-21) and flag discounts >10%.

I'll follow up with brief reminders on Friday and Monday. Thanks team.

—Logan Wright
